name: camayoc_ex_directives_about
description: Every directive about a subject, active or not, with what superseded each one.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?directive ?label ?supersededBy WHERE { ?directive a aegis:Directive ; aegis:about <{subject}> ; rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?directive aegis:supersededBy ?supersededBy } } ORDER BY ?label
